children: IB Acquisition announced a suite of financing agreements to support its pending merger with GNQ Insilico, including a $50.0 million equity purchase facility, a PIPE for senior secured convertible notes with an initial $16.47 million closing and potential additional closings up to $90 million, and related registration rights. The company also amended the Business Combination Agreement to remove the minimum cash condition, convert bridge obligations into PIPE notes at closing, and permit the new financings. A companion Registration Rights Agreement will facilitate resales under the ELOC. Together, these actions are intended to enhance liquidity and streamline closing of the merger.
